<bbm-response>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_0">"Please try using spatial teleportation on me, but let me know right after the calculation finishes and before the actual move."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_1">"No problem, dess."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_2">${黑子} walked over and placed a hand on ${一色}'s shoulder.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_3">"Lady ${一色}, are you ready?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_4">"OK, please activate it." ${一色} used Purification.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_5">"Eh?" ${黑子} appeared in the distance, while ${一色} stayed right where she was.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_6">A rare teleportation failure.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_7">"Based on how my ability judges things, ${黑子}'s coordinate calculations on me were probably judged as a mark, so I can probably nullify others' specific espers' abilities to a certain degree. Anyway, things like placing marks and mind control definitely won't work on me."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_8">${黑子} blinked back to her original spot in a flash, grabbing at empty air, still finding it hard to believe.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_9">"I see," ${美琴} said thoughtfully. "But wouldn't it be a bit troublesome if Shokuhou tampered with your common sense and made you define the effects she applies to you as normal?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_10">"That won't happen. Student ${操祈} only used mind control, memory reading, and mind-reading abilities on me. Mind control gets judged by me as hypnosis, and I have an item similar to an unconditioned reflex that grants immunity to control."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_11">Saying this, ${一色} materialized mercury in the palm of her hand, looking like an upside-down dark green cup.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_12">"Whoa, that's something I've never seen before," ${美琴} exclaimed in wonder.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_13">"${黑子} remembers that Lady ${一色}'s equipment needs to be worn to have an effect."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_14">"It's been massively upgraded now! Not only have the effects evolved, but the way they're used is also much more convenient." A pair of yellow boots with small wings appeared in ${一色}'s hand, and she instantly refined them into a golden light that sank into ${美琴}'s body.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_15">"Whoa, what's going on? ${一色}, don't go putting strange things into my body!" ${美琴} checked herself up and down.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_16">"Relax, relax. Big Sis, try running around and see." ${一色} pushed ${美琴}'s back.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_17">"Eh—alright, I'll give it a try." ${美琴} broke into a jog and found that she effortlessly reached her previous top-speed running pace, and exerting more force underfoot took her speed to an even higher level.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_18">"It really works!" ${美琴} stopped, looked back at ${一色} and ${黑子}, and waved at them. Within three to four seconds, she had already run about fifty meters.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_19">${一色} conjured a pair of red boots with blue rims, turned them into a ball of light, and tossed it into ${黑子}'s arms.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_20">${黑子} blinked.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_21">"Try activating your ability." ${一色} winked.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_22">"What kind of effect does this have?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_23">"It slightly increases movement speed and reduces casting cooldown. In short, you run faster, and ${黑子} can use spatial teleportation at a higher frequency. As for the operating mechanism, it probably boosts ${黑子}'s calculation capacity?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_24">"I see. Then ${黑子} will give it a try."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_25">${黑子} blinked five times between the two endpoints of ${美琴} and ${一色}, finally stopping beside ${美琴}, and muttered to herself, "It really did get faster. It comprehensively enhances ability activation and calculation efficiency, and there's no noticeable change in the consumption of ${黑子}'s mental energy."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_26">"的原石 abilities are really incredible," ${美琴} remarked with a sigh.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_27">${一色} chased after them. "This is just the tip of the iceberg."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_28">${美琴} raised her hand and stroked ${一色}'s head. "You're amazing."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_29">${黑子} showed a strong interest in ${一色}'s ability, pressing on: "Lady ${一色}, may I ask what the duration and effective range of your ability are? Can a single person trigger multiple effects simultaneously?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_30">"I haven't tested the time and range. I can wear multiple pieces of equipment myself, but for people other than me, can we only give them one for now?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_31">"Even so, such high versatility and effectiveness easily reach the level of a Level 4 High Esper."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_32">"Congratulations, ${一色}! Double happiness indeed. There's a physical examination in a couple of days, so we can verify just how far you can go then!"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_33">"Ahaha, this is actually just a part of my ability... Hehe, who knows, I might even end up stronger than Big Sis? By then, I'll really be the one covering you, Big Sis."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_34">"Eh—you sure talk big, considering you're just a little sister."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_35">"Hehe."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_36">Chapter 22: Is This a Giant Confucian?</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_37">Passing through several blocks of Garden of Learners.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_38">${一色} finally set foot on the soil of ${常盘台中学}. The long-awaited girls' middle school life begins now!</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pbaa5ca72ec06_39">${常盘台中学}, the cradle of espers, is famous for cultivating high-level espers. Students are required to reach at least Level 3 to enroll. The most representative figures among the students are undoubtedly ${御坂美琴} and ${食蜂操祈}.</bbm-unit>
</bbm-response>
